note: One list of the files a merge never needs a person for (build lander-regenerates-generated-files-clash, Nov 13 2026). Read by the auto-land runner and the merge queue (the push banner plugin's land/land-core.mjs) and by the vps.build_land resolver (framework/cli/land-resolve.py, run as /opt/axf-batch/resolve.py). `files` are matched in order against the repo path of a conflicted file. merge = regen (main's copy, then the named generator runs on the merged tree), union-json (both sides' keys kept, 3-way by key, main wins a scalar clash), union-lines (git merge-file --union), main (main's copy is enough). A generator's `run` and `outputs` may use {app} for the app folder caught by the pattern's `app` group; an `optional` generator that refuses to run leaves main's copy in place instead of stopping the land. A generator's `check` runs after it; `tests` run whenever a generated or union file was resolved.
